about: NSFG 2022-2023 female respondent file: the CSV has no value labels and the codebook (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/data/nsfg/codebooks/2022-2023-NSFG-FemRespPUFCodebook.pdf) is not in raw/ (cdc.gov is unreachable from the agent containers; fetch.py downloads only the data zips). Every 'candidate_*' coding below is UNCONFIRMED: it comes from the analyst's recollection of earlier NSFG codebooks plus the structural checks recorded in data/surveys/questions.json diagnostics, and build_surveys.py publishes no estimate for a variable until 'confirmed_from' names the codebook page or file that confirms it. To confirm: open the codebook, check each code, set confirmed_from to e.g. 'FemResp codebook p.123 (2022-2023)', fix any code that differs, rebuild.

AGE_R.label_text: Variable name AGE_R; the file's readme calls it "R's age at interview AGE_R with values 15-49" (full question wording not in raw/).
AGE_R.coding_source: raw/nsfg/.../NSFG_2022_2023_FemRespPUFData_readme.txt names AGE_R as age at interview, values 15-49 (one record has 50).

ADDEXP.label_text: Variable name ADDEXP only (a recode; no label or wording in raw/). Candidate meaning: central number of additional births the respondent expects.

candidate_response_map.0-110 step 5: candidate: expected additional births x 10 (half-births from 'between' answers)

ADDEXP.coding_source: candidate only: raw values are 0,5,10,...,110 (multiples of 5, suggesting births x 10); scale and meaning not confirmed from any file in raw/
ADDEXP.note: Expected births: a different measure from ideal family size (SPEC 5.2). Never compared with GSS CHLDIDEL as if equivalent.

INTENT.label_text: Variable name INTENT only (a recode; no label or wording in raw/). Candidate meaning: whether the respondent intends to have (more) children.
INTENT.coding_source: candidate only: four raw codes (1, 2, 3, 4) observed; meaning of code 4 not known; nothing in raw/ confirms any of them
INTENT.note: Intended births: a different measure from ideal family size.

RELIGION.label_text: Variable name RELIGION only (a recode of current religious affiliation; no label or wording in raw/).
RELIGION.coding_source: candidate only: four raw codes observed; recollection of earlier NSFG recodes

ATTNDNOW.label_text: Variable name ATTNDNOW only (no label or wording in raw/). Candidate meaning: current frequency of attending religious services.

candidate_response_map.1: candidate: more than once a week

ATTNDNOW.coding_source: candidate only: raw codes 1-9 observed; recollection of the NSFG 1-7 attendance scale with 8/9 refused/don't know

FMARITAL.label_text: Variable name FMARITAL only (a recode of formal marital status; no label or wording in raw/).
FMARITAL.coding_source: candidate only: structural check FMARITAL==5 coincides case-for-case with EVRMARRY==0 (see diagnostics), consistent with 5 = never married, but EVRMARRY's own coding is also unconfirmed
